2,304 likes, 58 comments - debasreee on October 5, 2026: "Shobai eshechhilo!! 😍❤️

Thank you Kolkata, for one of the most memorable birthday celebrations. 🙏🏽 Tomra shobai eto shundor kore sheje eshechhile je, shei din-er vibe ta puro Durga Pujo’r moto lagchhilo! 🥹❤️

Tomader shobar shathe kotha bole khub bhalo legechhe. Thank you for sharing your stories with me, for taking the time to come, and for making the day so special.

Tomader shobar creator journey’r jonno onek onek bhalobasha aar shubhechha. Ami mon theke chai tomra khub aagey jao, nijeder moto kore grow koro, aar shob success pao ja tomra deserve koro. ❤️

See you again soon! 😘🥰💕".
